title: Grill — one Select Projects control for New Task

branch-rows.title: Where do the per-project Branch / Pull / Fetch rows live, and in what order?
branch-rows.display: Inline: button → branch rows → Isolate → Branch name
branch-rows.note: btw, we're removing the one project/branch selection

apply-boundary.title: Does the selection apply on Save, or immediately on every toggle?
apply-boundary.note: and avoid closing the modal/dialog when clicking outside

scope.title: Does the combined control apply to the issue dialog too, or only New Task?
scope.display: Both surfaces; the issue's repo stays locked first
scope.note: issues, pr, resolve conflicts from the pr, new task, etc.

minimum-one.title: “One selection is required” — what happens when the user tries to deselect the last project?
minimum-one.display: Allow zero in the draft; Save disabled with a “select at least one” hint

button-label.title: What exactly does the button say for 1 and for 2+ selected projects?
button-label.note: but keep listing the project and branch selected under that, like we have today

tag-sha.title: Do we keep a way to pin a tag or commit SHA per project?
tag-sha.display: Branch rows only (parity with the single project)

auto-select.title: Auto-select the most recently added project when the form opens with nothing selected

isolate-collapse.title: When a 2+ selection drops back to one project, what happens to Isolate?

pull-fetch.title: Per-project Pull/Fetch exactly as today, with no “Pull all” / “Fetch all”
pull-fetch.value: Per-row Pull/Fetch only; no bulk action

dialog-actions.title: Dialog affordances: search, the three management actions, and the zero-project state
dialog-actions.value: Add a search filter; move Browse for folder / Clone repository / Import sessions into the dialog; keep the button enabled even with no projects registered

row-label-remove.title: How each per-project row is identified, and how a project is removed
row-label-remove.value: Rows read “Branch · <project name>” (path added when two names collide); removal happens only in the Select Projects dialog — no per-row X

branch-name.title: One shared Branch name for all projects, previewed from the first selected project's naming config
branch-name.value: One shared field; the preview uses the first selected project's `branchConfig`; the server applies one name with a per-repo `-N` fallback

deduped-count.title: The button count and the forced Isolate both use the git-root-deduped set
deduped-count.value: Yes — count what the server will create, and keep the “(some share a git root)” note

keep-selection.title: After creating a task, keep the whole project selection for the next task
keep-selection.value: Keep every selected project (and each branch ref) for the next task
